rules.statement: The design under verification has exactly one hart and one timer (N_HARTS = 1, N_TIMERS = 1).
Every register access is permitted when RACL is disabled.
No register access is rejected for an access-control reason.
The alert sender of rv_timer and the alert receiver of the wrapper both use the synchronous clocking scheme, with no synchronizer flops on the differential pairs.
Alert ping requests are never issued.
Every run uses the single fixed configuration; there is no design parameter to vary.
